name: io.github.HurleySk/ado-search-mcp
description: MCP server that wraps the ado-search CLI for Azure DevOps work item search and management

tools.name: ado_search
tools.description: Full-text search of indexed Azure DevOps work items and wiki pages

tools.name: ado_grep
tools.description: Regex pattern search across work item fields

tools.name: ado_children
tools.description: List children/descendants of a work item

tools.name: ado_show
tools.description: Show full content of a work item or wiki page

tools.name: ado_list_links
tools.description: List links on a work item (live from ADO)

tools.name: ado_list_comments
tools.description: List comments on a work item (live from ADO)

tools.name: ado_fetch
tools.description: Fetch specific work items by ID into local store

tools.name: ado_create
tools.description: Create a new work item in Azure DevOps

tools.name: ado_add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a work item

tools.name: ado_add_link
tools.description: Add a link between two work items

tools.name: ado_remove_link
tools.description: Remove a link between two work items

environmentVariables.name: ADO_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Path to ado-search data directory (fallback if no config file)
